campaign_candidate: CAMPAIGN-CANDIDATE-001: CNC Intelligence Impersonation Recovery Scam Network

characteristics.brand_target: CNC Intelligence Inc. (cncintel.com) — legitimate crypto investigation firm
characteristics.fraud_type: Advance-fee recovery scam (victims of prior scams are targeted for 'recovery' fees)
characteristics.modus_operandi: Register lookalike domains, use email (ProtonMail) to contact victims, claim to be CNC Intelligence representatives, request crypto payments for 'recovery services'
characteristics.domain_patterns: cncintel*, cnc-intel*, cncintell* — all contain 'cncintel' brand name
characteristics.registrars: NameCheap (primary), NameSilo, Hostinger — low-cost registrars commonly used for bulk domain registration
characteristics.email_service: ProtonMail — encrypted email service that provides privacy
characteristics.scale: 50+ domains documented, multiple victim reports, FBI action against connected entities

similarity_indicators.domain_naming: All use variations of 'cncintel' brand name
similarity_indicators.infrastructure: Different from legitimate site (no Cloudflare, no Zoho, no enterprise verification)
similarity_indicators.email_config: ProtonMail MX records (encrypted email for anonymity)
similarity_indicators.targeting: Victims of prior crypto scams seeking recovery (advance-fee fraud pattern)

false_positive_check: The legitimate CNC Intelligence (cncintel.com) uses Cloudflare + Zoho + Google/OpenAI verification — distinctly different infrastructure from all fraudulent domains. No false positives identified.
confidence: HIGH that this is a coordinated campaign. MEDIUM on attribution to a single operator group.
limitations: Cannot confirm single operator. Multiple independent actors may be using the same brand impersonation pattern.
